name: Knights of Columbus

summary.text: The Knights of Columbus, a Catholic fraternal order, says that in April 1951 its board required Fourth Degree assemblies to recite the Pledge with 'under God,' that its Supreme Council in 1952 urged Congress and the White House to add the words, that Supreme Knight Luke Hart won the support of 110 other fraternal societies through the National Fraternal Congress and met Eisenhower in 1953, and that Eisenhower thanked Hart after signing the law on June 14, 1954.

sources.title: The History of the Knights of Columbus: One Nation Under God
U.S. Presidents and the Knights of Columbus

facts.claim: In April 1951 the Knights' board of directors required assemblies to recite the pledge with 'under God' included, three years before the change was passed into law.
facts.quote: required assemblies to recite the pledge with "under God" included, three years before the change is passed into law

sources.title: The History of the Knights of Columbus: One Nation Under God

facts.claim: In 1952 the Supreme Council adopted a resolution urging Congress and the White House to add 'under God'; Supreme Knight Luke Hart, also president of the National Fraternal Congress, persuaded the other 110 fraternal societies to support it.
facts.quote: persuaded the other 110 fraternal societies to support the resolution as well

sources.title: The History of the Knights of Columbus: One Nation Under God

facts.claim: Hart met Eisenhower on the issue in 1953; after signing the law on Flag Day, June 14, 1954, Eisenhower wrote to thank Hart for the order's work.
facts.quote: in a letter following the action, President Eisenhower thanked Supreme Knight Hart for the K of C's work

sources.title: The History of the Knights of Columbus: One Nation Under God
U.S. Presidents and the Knights of Columbus

openQuestions: The Knights' campaign was conducted through its own resolutions and lobbying; no separate funding figure for it is given on its pages. Independent historians credit Rep. Louis Rabaut and Rev. George Docherty's February 1954 sermon as well.
